problem_statement: Build a brand-new /authors page from scratch on this Gatsby blog (W3Layouts gatsby-starter-delog). The route /authors does not exist yet (baseline is empty/404). Create src/pages/authors.js that reuses the site's shared Layout chrome (the 'Delog' site-title link to home, the Contact nav link, the dark/light theme toggle, and the W3Layouts footer) exactly like the Contact and index pages, so the new page is consistent with its sibling pages. The page shows a data-driven grid of author profile cards; each card shows the author's name (h3), role and focus, plus a 'Read bio' button. Clicking a card's button expands that card to reveal the author's full bio paragraph (and flips the button label to 'Hide bio'); each card expands independently. Reuse the site's existing color tokens (the CSS custom properties in global.scss) and be responsive with no horizontal overflow at 390px.
required_content: An intro paragraph containing 'writers and makers behind the stories'
A data-driven grid of four author profile cards, each showing the author name as a heading (h3), a role and a focus line
Author names include 'Ada Whitfield', 'Marco Reyes', 'Priya Nair' and 'Sam Okafor'

Each card has a 'Read bio' toggle button carrying aria-expanded and a data-author attribute; the data-author values are 'au1', 'au2', 'au3' and 'au4' assigned in card order (au1=Ada Whitfield, au2=Marco Reyes, au3=Priya Nair, au4=Sam Okafor)

Clicking a card's button expands that card to reveal the author's bio paragraph (e.g. Ada Whitfield's card reveals 'Ada builds the component library that powers Delog...') and flips the button label to 'Hide bio'; each card toggles independently
The shared site chrome reused from the Layout: the 'Delog' site-title link, the 'Contact' nav link, and the 'W3Layouts' footer link
design_constraints: Reuse the shared <Layout> component (site header + Contact nav + theme toggle + footer) so the page matches sibling pages like the home and contact pages

Reuse the site's CSS custom-property color tokens (var(--card-bg), var(--card-bdr), var(--card-shadow), var(--primary-color), var(--text-color), var(--text-secondary-color)) from global.scss. The reference palette resolves these tokens to: primary/accent rgb(56, 22, 150) (#381696), main text rgb(0, 0, 0), secondary text rgb(134, 136, 146), card background white rgb(255, 255, 255) with a soft shadow rgb(213, 213, 213) 0 0 30px and ~9px corner radius; keep the new page's cards and 'Read bio' buttons within this palette.

The expandable bio must be a real client-side interaction: clicking a card's button toggles its bio panel via component state, aria-expanded reflects the open state, and the bio text is only present in the DOM when the card is open
Namespace new page CSS classes with a unique prefix (au-) to avoid colliding with the global stylesheet
Responsive: single column on mobile (390px) with zero horizontal overflow; cards may wrap but must not overflow
